decisions.reason: Its quantified adoption by the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes shows realized value, so the option has resolved favorably and the product is worth keeping.
Prospects remain uncertain but carrying costs are low and the firm holds few other options, so the option value justifies keeping it on the market.
The product is close to the established offer and still uncertain rather than clearly failing, so as a low-cost option it should be retained.
